channel.title: Morning Gas & Energy Brief
channel.description: Phil's weekday morning brief: North American natural gas, Alberta weather and Lower-48 degree days, energy M&A, and geopolitics. Generated and narrated by Claude.
channel.itunes:author: Claude for Phil

item.title: Mon Aug 17 — Gas slips on record supply; TTF at three-week high
item.description: Sept Nymex gives back Friday's rally amid record production and a 198 Bcf storage surplus; heat holds in the South; Iran talks stall and TTF tops 62 euros; Senate passes Russia sanctions bill.

item.title: Fri Aug 14 — Bearish storage miss knocks gas lower
item.description: EIA +36 Bcf vs +31 expected; Henry Hub ~$2.73; heat holds through late August; Expand Energy buys Twin Eagle for $1.25B; TTF near €60 on Hormuz impasse.

item.title: Thu Aug 13 — Gas rally tests $2.80 into storage day
item.description: September gas at $2.797, best close since Jul 24; EIA build seen ~28-31 Bcf; Hormuz talks deadlocked; TTF near €60.

item.title: Wed Aug 12 — EIA cuts gas outlook, sees sub-$3 into winter
item.description: Henry Hub slips to $2.77 as record supply beats hot forecasts; STEO cuts outlook 50c; CPC turns hotter; Hormuz partial-reopening talks; CPI today.

item.title: Tue Aug 11 — Gas jumps most since May
item.description: Hotter forecasts and record short-covering lift September gas ~4%; feedgas at one-month high; TTF +10% on Hormuz; EIA Thursday.

item.title: Mon Aug 10 — Gas heavy on record supply; Senate sanctions
item.description: Henry Hub mid-$2.60s after a 33 Bcf build; Freeport maintenance caps feedgas; Senate passes Russia-Iran sanctions; Hormuz deal chatter; CPI Wednesday.

item.title: Fri Aug 7 — Bigger storage build pins gas near lows
item.description: EIA +33 Bcf; September Henry Hub ~$2.64 at multi-month lows; hot now but mid-August cooldown east; Qatar force majeure and Hormuz risk keep TTF bid; jobs day.

item.title: Thu Aug 6 — Gas at three-month lows into storage day
item.description: Sep gas near $2.67 at fresh 3-month lows; EIA storage due; Hormuz reopening talks sink oil and TTF; Expand/Twin Eagle; Alberta warm then showers.

item.title: Wed Aug 5 — Three-month gas low; Iran hopes sink oil
item.description: September gas near $2.69 on record supply and Freeport outage; Brent under $79 on US-Iran deal hopes; EIA storage Thursday.

item.title: Tue Aug 4 — Gas steadies under two-eighty as heat returns
item.description: September gas holds ~$2.79 as record supply meets returning heat; Iran ceasefire whipsaw hits crude; OPEC+ adds 188k bpd for September; TTF still wears the war premium.

item.title: Mon Aug 3 — Gas at summer lows; oil dives as Iran strike called off
item.description: September gas ~$2.76 after -15% July on record 110.7 Bcf/d output; Trump halts Iran strikes, WTI -5.6%, TTF -4%; OPEC+ final +188k bpd; Calgary heat to 31C.

item.title: Fri Jul 31 — Storage surprise lifts gas; Qatar reopens Hormuz LNG
item.description: September gas bounces to $2.74 on a 28 Bcf build vs 35+ expected; Qatar's first Hormuz LNG transit in three weeks; Fed holds; Amazon soars, Apple slides.

item.title: Thu Jul 30 — Gas near lows as Mideast war premium builds
item.description: September takes over near $2.71 with record supply and a 6.4% storage surplus; overnight US strikes on Iran lift oil and the winter strip; EIA storage due; Calgary hits 33 Saturday.

item.title: Wed Jul 29 — Gas probes multiyear lows into August expiry
item.description: Henry Hub ~$2.69 into today's August expiry on record supply and Freeport maintenance; Brent +5% on Saudi drone attacks; EIA storage and the Fed on deck.
